# Rowing Stronger

> > Comprehensive rowing performance resource covering strength training, injury prevention, and coaching by Will Ruth, featuring the free "Rowing Stronger" book and evidence-based training guides.

Created by Will Ruth (Norwich University S&C coach, former Craftsbury GRP coach), this site provides research-backed resources for rowers and coaches on strength training periodization, injury management, and performance optimization. Features contributions from experts like Blake Gourley, Joe DeLeo, and Dr. Lisa Lowe.

## Key Topics

- Rowing strength training
- Injury prevention
- Rowing performance
- Low back pain management
- Rib stress injury
- Periodization
- Core training
- Deadlifting technique
- Power testing
- Program design
- Rowing technique
- Body composition
- Warmup protocols
- Upper body training
- Return to training

## Getting Started

- [Rowing Stronger Homepage](https://rowingstronger.com): Homepage with guides, articles & resources for rowing performance
- [Start Here](https://rowingstronger.com/start): Main landing page for rowing performance, technique & injury prevention
- [Get Started](https://rowingstronger.com/get-started): Curated collection of popular resources, Youtube videos & book intro
- [About Will Ruth](https://rowingstronger.com/about): Will Ruth's bio: Norwich University S&C coach, former Craftsbury GRP coach
- ["Rowing Stronger" Book](https://rowingstronger.com/book): Free PDF & print editions with 2024 Five-Year Update to 2019 edition

## Injury Prevention & Management

- [Rowing Low Back Pain Guide](https://rowingstronger.com/2024/05/29/rowing-low-back-pain-guide): Complete guide to preventing & managing non-specific low back pain
- [Rowing Rib Stress Injury Guide](https://rowingstronger.com/2024/05/29/rowing-rib-stress-injury-guide): Practical guide to rib stress injuries: prevention, management & recovery
- [Rowing Injuries: Understanding, Preventing, and Managing](https://rowingstronger.com/2024/05/19/rowing-injuries-understanding-preventing-managing): Comprehensive injury guide using biopsychosocial model & rehabilitation

## Strength Training Guides

- [Modern Rowing Strength Training Key Concepts](https://rowingstronger.com/2024/02/24/modern-rowing-strength-training-key-concepts): Foundational philosophy on modern rowing strength training methods
- [Rowing Strength Training Program Priorities](https://rowingstronger.com/2023/02/12/rowing-strength-training-program-priorities): Five priorities for exercise selection, performance & annual program design
- [Deadlifting for Rowing: The Complete Guide](https://rowingstronger.com/2019/01/07/deadlifting-for-rowing-complete-guide): Step-by-step deadlift technique for rowing performance & posterior chain
- [Upper Body Training for Rowing](https://rowingstronger.com/2019/05/13/upper-body-training-for-rowing): Upper body strength for force transfer & injury prevention (ribs, back)
- [Core Training for Rowing](https://rowingstronger.com/2016/05/02/core-training-for-rowing): Rowing-specific core training: trunk stability, seated rockback & TRX work
- [Rowing Warmup: The Complete Guide](https://rowingstronger.com/2017/04/02/rowing-warmup-complete-guide): 10-15 min full-body warmup sequences for rowing, erging & strength training

## Performance & Testing

- [All About Rowing Power Testing](https://rowingstronger.com/2021/04/26/all-about-rowing-power-testing): Complete guide to erg power testing protocols, analysis & training apps
- [Gaining Muscle, Losing Bodyfat, and Rowing Training](https://rowingstronger.com/2023/11/27/gaining-muscle-losing-bodyfat-rowing-training): Body composition strategies for rowers: muscle gain, fat loss & training
- [Five-Year Update to Rowing Stronger](https://rowingstronger.com/2024/02/06/five-year-update-to-rowing-stronger-second-edition): 2024 coaching changes vs 2019: periodization, VBT & plyometrics updates

## Reference & Resources

- [Article Index](https://rowingstronger.com/article-index): Searchable index of all RowingStronger articles with keywords & summaries
- [Exercise Index](https://rowingstronger.com/exercise-index): Youtube video library of exercises with technique cues & spreadsheet index
- [Downloads](https://rowingstronger.com/downloads): Free PDF downloads of Rowing Stronger book & training resources
